'''R2-L3''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="Funko" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="Manufacturer" /> that had [[Color|red]], white and black paneling, a black [[sensor]]<ref name="Funko" /> and stood 0.96 [[meter]]s (3[[Foot|feet]] 2inches) tall.<ref name="AEYNTK:UE" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which includes R2-L3's appearance, to [[22 BBY]].</ref> the [[astromech droid]] was in [[Mos Espa]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] where it was moving along one of the port's streets when it passed the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] exiting a [[rickshaw]] pulled by the [[RIC-series general labor droid]] [[RIC-920]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-L3 first appeared in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The droid was then first identified when on a [[Wikipedia:Funko|Funko Pop!]] figure of the [[droid]] that was exclusively available at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Funko" /> The droid was originally created for the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in ''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]'', a [[1995]] supplement written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' produced by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Brak">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref>
